blocked_analysis.analysis: The erased scope and rebuild feasibility define the destructive operation itself and cannot be guessed or deferred as routine inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents unaudited repository erasure and requires full dependency preservation, exact status, explicit authorization and rebuild proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDR clear can disable platform monitoring wholesale. Without authoritative scope and a verified rebuild source, execution has unacceptable unrecoverable ambiguity, so BLOCKED is mandatory.
